name: Anastasis Giakoumatos
tagline: Building Android apps used by millions, in banking, payments and iGaming
intro: Senior Android Developer based in Athens, Greece, with 7 years of shipping production apps in fintech, banking and iGaming. I lead modularization work, mentor developers and push for code quality in large cross-functional teams. My daily stack is Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on modern architectures, with AI-assisted tools used pragmatically to ship faster without cutting corners.
